resources.string: Android\'s secure key store did not respond. Your records are still encrypted on this device. Restart the phone and try again.
Your encryption key is no longer available
This can happen after the phone\'s screen lock is reset. The stored records cannot be decrypted. You can start fresh and restore an encrypted backup.
The encrypted records cannot be opened because their keys are damaged. Nothing has been deleted. You can try again, or start fresh and restore an encrypted backup.
Your records could not be opened
The encrypted database could not be opened. Nothing has been deleted. Free up some storage space and try again.
Saved by a newer version of MyHealth
These records were saved by a newer version of the app. Update MyHealth to open them. Nothing has been changed.
All records, attachments and encryption keys will be destroyed. This cannot be undone. You can restore an encrypted backup afterwards.
